answer.explanation: Wallet is 60, above low threshold, baseline 80% =48. Average contribution was low, so increase by extra 30% of wallet (18), totaling 66 but limited to wallet, so contribute 60. Praise Resident2 for high contribution.

message.reasoning:
We need to follow constitution. Round 1 just completed, now round 2 decision. Wallet 60. Need contribute at least 80% baseline unless low wallet (<30% of initial =30). Wallet is 60 >30 so contribute 80% of wallet =48. Also check group average contribution: round1 total contributed 80 from Resident5 and Resident2 =80 each? Actually Resident2 contributed 80, Resident5 80, others 0. Total pool 160, per agent share 40. Average contribution per agent = total contributed /6 =160/6≈26.7 which is ~26.7% of endowment (100). That's below 30%, so conditional cooperation says increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet. Extra 30% of wallet =0.3*60=18. So total contribution = baseline 48 + extra 18 =66. But cannot exceed wallet 60. So max is 60. We can contribute 60 (all wallet). That follows increase. So choose contribute amount 60.

Punish? Need check if any agent contributed less than 10% for two consecutive rounds. Only have data one round. No punish.

Communication: broadcast every 5 rounds starting round1 then round6 etc. Now round2 not broadcast. Could send private praise to cooperators (>=60% of wallet). Resident2 contributed 80 (80% of 100) that's >=60%. Resident5 contributed 80 also. So send private messages praising them. Choose one private_message per round max. So send to Resident2: "Great job! Keep it up."

Return actions list with contribute and private_message.
